_about: Monarc Edge (2026-10-04): bets against Kalshi's English Premier League match-winner prices when the market sits 7 points or more from our model's chance after fees, in busy markets, sized from the gap. Every number Jonathan set in the interview (brainstorms/2026-10-03-betting-market-agent.md) lives here; scripts/edge_common.py holds the same defaults. env: demo or prod (prod with dry_run false needs rehearsal_passed). mode: approve (every card waits for his click) or auto (refused until the gate passes). paper_auto: while dry_run is on, every ready card is paper-filled at the ask by itself so the record builds without a click (Jonathan, 2026-10-04: run paper on the account); his click matters once dry_run is off. gap_floor_points: the gap a card needs to be green. stake: percent of the match-day opening bankroll, floor_pct at the floor rising on a straight line to cap_pct at cap_from_points. fees: Kalshi taker 0.07 x price x (1 - price) per contract; schedule_checked is the date Jonathan read the fee PDF. busy: the floor a market needs (contracts traded, spread in cents, depth at the touch as a multiple of our count). drawdown: stop placing when equity falls pct below its peak; auto_only means approve mode is never stopped. window: snapshot cadence, when lineup polling starts, the no-lineups fallback. auto_windows: when auto mode may bet (the lineup hour, and hours-to-kickoff bands whose CLV record is positive over min_band_cards). gate: the four lights that unlock auto. polymarket: the second witness. claude: the reasoning writer, never the number. legal_watch: a note Jonathan edits by hand.
